title: Critique: emergentist forms lose the integration of consciousness

statements.text: If macro experience emerges from quiddities by causal laws that physics does not entail, those laws are like the psychophysical laws of interactionist dualism, and the charge against dualism applies again. If high-level intrinsic properties are not constituted by low-level ones while the low level is causally closed, they are epiphenomenal all over again.

sources.quote: on the causal-emergence construal, that charge would apply equally to Russellian monism
the high-level intrinsic properties will be epiphenomenal all over again
